category_meanings.C: Existing preview/presentation derivations; reconstruction requires fixed code and preserved complete inputs
category_meanings.D: Known browser/resource/engineering work products; not certified deletable
category_meanings.U: Unknown purpose, credentials, unclassified shared objects; protected

future_growth: New source bodies and per-stock daily fact shards dominate quote-only writes; no daily full-history/result/chart duplication is required. Full graph/indicator cache retention requires a later explicit policy.
physical_accounting: Unique(device,inode) st_blocks*512; shared inode assigned once with protective U>A>B>C>D priority. No extent/reflink or byte-identical different-inode dedup inferred. Directory metadata not included in file allocation totals.

reconstruction.A: Not reconstructible from summaries; original evidence retained
reconstruction.B: Exact historical evidence retained; no deletion authorization
reconstruction.C: Conditional only, no full regeneration performed
reconstruction.D: Engineering purpose does not prove redundancy; all retained
